comparison.contour: Painted mountains/foliage/Roshan use irregular modeled contour turns; theater curtains have large straight polygon facets and even straight stripes. Notes, target and pips use exact circles/stock glyph forms. Daddy has a conspicuous white sticker contour unlike painted Roshan/background.
comparison.material: Curtain, bulbs, rainbow rails and note/target fills remain uniform graphic patches rather than the painted value groups visible in grass, clothing and character scales. Canvas rendering does not change flat artwork into painted art.
comparison.palette: Bright pink/purple framing, rainbow rails and large green target dominate the cooler painted garden. Note colors are gameplay coding and must remain readable during repair; approved source colors stay preserved.
comparison.light: Painted surroundings have modeled forms and soft character highlights. Flat curtain stripes/bulbs lack material-specific lighting. Do not relight approved scene art.
comparison.perspective: Proscenium and rail are frontal screen overlays around a scenic garden view. Available painted room-curtain sources include a closed door and their own depth, so direct whole-image fit is not established.
comparison.scale: The1600view expands the stage horizontally while large note/target sizes persist. Target dominates the scenic area and Daddy is a small hovering sticker at right. Phone-size ratios remain unreviewed.
comparison.contact: Roshan and Daddy tails appear unsupported relative to the painted ground in viewed rest states. Current staging is observed, not accepted acting/contact.
comparison.occlusion: Side curtains intrude on scenic view and Daddy sits in front of the right curtain. Final seventh release closes the theater into medal layers; that capture and paused sheet are excluded from theater credits.
comparison.readability: Large green circle and note glyph make the desktop native target conspicuous; smaller progress pips/faces still require actual non-reader/device review. No phone squint or human acceptance inferred.
comparison.action_state: Real screen-touch press/release advances all seven notes at both aspects with color changes/checked pips. Sparse checkpoints do not review continuous motion/contact/transitions. Normal entry and DL-QA-11 remain unproved.
